# API/SDK Downloadï

This page provides a comprehensive list of downloadable CLO SDK (API/Plugin) packages for different software versions.

For each CLO release and patch version, you can find:

Version information: including Official Releases and Official Patches

SDK package download links: available for both Windows and macOS, with multiple hosting options such as S3 and OSS

Special notices: for obsolete versions or important changes (e.g., format updates, compatibility notes)
